newsitem.title: USA: Boyd Gaming to buy Treasure Chest casino.
newsitem.headline: Boyd Gaming to buy Treasure Chest casino.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp Tuesday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the 85 percent of Treasure Chest LLC that it does not already own for $115 million including debt assumption.
Treasure Chest owns the Treasure Chest Casino in the New Orleans area, and Boyd has been managing it since it opened in September 1994, the company said in a statement.
Boyd invested $15 million for a 15 percent share in 1994.
Boyd expects to fund the acquisition and debt repayment using its existing bank credit line. Closing the deal requires approval of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board.

"Because we've operated the property since its inception, we anticipate few transition issues which could interfere with its successful operating performance," said William Boyd, chief executive officer. "From a financial perspective, this acquisition is expected to be accretive to Boyd's earnings."
Boyd said the total investment is roughly 3.8 times Treasure Chest's trailing 12-month operating cash flow. It gives the company a sixth property.

Treasure Chest operates on Lake Pontchartrain in Kenner, La. The riverboat casino has 24,000 square feet of gaming space on three decks, 905 slot machines and 61 tables games. An adjoining entertainment area houses a 200-seat buffet, a 75-seat restaurant and a lounge. It caters primarily to local residents and has reported the highest gaming revenue among all New Orleans riverboat casinos each and every month since its September 1994 opening.
